mechanism_narrative: A rising CPIAUCSL (consumer price index) indicates accelerating inflation, which typically triggers central bank tightening and higher discount rates, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals a tight labor market that accelerates wage inflation and prompts monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of triggered instances, or average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate a collapsing housing sector, which signals broader economic weakness and triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of instances when both RSAFS and HOUST decline, or Rank IC for joint signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During active monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), a CPIAUCSL above 210 signals persistent inflation, leading to further rate hikes and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and CPIAUCSL > 210, or Rank IC for interaction signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates weakening economic activity, reducing corporate earnings growth and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO declines, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When real estate sales (RSAFS) exceed 385,000 million dollars, it signals robust consumer demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS > 385000, or average return in triggered periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in employment (PAYEMS) and decreases in unemployment (UNRATE) signal a rapidly tightening labor market, generating wage inflation pressures that trigger negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls, or Rank IC for joint signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During strong economic expansion (GDPC1 annual growth > 1.5%), a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals sector-specific weakness that triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances when GDPC1 annual growth > 1.5% and HOUST declines, or Rank IC for interaction signal is below 0.03.
